blindReviewDeclaration: Fresh independent reviewer formed the falsification findings from governing sources and current implementation bytes before reading any author conclusions. No separate author-intake artifact existed; the required design-intake was reviewed as the subject under test.
expectedBehavior: The five-file owner/consumer correction must emit the unchanged canonical delete and temporary-promotion response shapes.
Any executable literal final DAG must declare every changed catalog, checker, materializer, executor and test source before implementation.
Operations promotion remains selected-node, live-capability, server-grant and owner-recheck governed; platform sessions never substitute workspace capability.

findings.title: The bound design cannot pass its declared granularity admission
findings.evidence: Fresh scripts/check/implementation-design-granularity --manifest ... --review ... fails DESIGN_IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORITY_NOT_FALSE. The checker requires a raw implementationAuthority: false line in the bound design; the design intake uses only Markdown inline-code formatting.
findings.risk: The design package's declared mechanical admission cannot validate the reviewed bytes, so an apparent self-test PASS could be mistaken for actual package admission.
findings.disposition: AUTHOR_ACTION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_GO: make the design declaration checker-recognized, or make a justified compatible checker change with red proof.

findings.title: One five-file delivery unit cannot also materialize the claimed literal 396-row graph
findings.evidence: FINAL-U02 lists only five owner/consumer sources but its approved assertion and ordered chain require the literal DAG to replace stateKey/producerReadbackKey and be directly consumed. Current backend-performance-final-fixture-catalog.json still has 1,054 stateKey and 592 producerReadbackKey occurrences; its checker, fixture materializer, workload executor and focused tests are absent from the declared change surfaces.
findings.risk: The actual changed-path and incremental-receipt denominator cannot close, and static implementation could either change undeclared runtime-adjacent sources or leave the alleged executable graph unimplemented behind a five-file green package.
findings.disposition: AUTHOR_ACTION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_GO: split the five-file response correction from a separately bounded literal-DAG delivery unit, or declare all literal-DAG sources, red fixtures and package-exit denominator.

findings.title: Declared proof misses the HTTP authorization-to-owner promotion handoff
findings.evidence: The only new backend tests are owner tests. CatalogTemporaryPromotionContractTest checks validation/projection and OperationsCatalogInventoryControllerRouteTest reflects category route annotations; neither proves temporary-promotion itemCode/dataNodeRef/brand handoff, selected-node/capability enforcement, server grant, owner recheck or one-envelope edge response.
findings.risk: A local owner-shape test can pass while the governed operations HTTP path drifts, contradicting the design's stated normal owner-HTTP lifecycle and authorization preservation claim.
findings.disposition: AUTHOR_ACTION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_GO: add one focused edge integration test source to the exact surface, covering normal lifecycle plus wrong-scope rejection without changing any API or authorization policy.

findings.title: 396/592/113 is reproducible baseline accounting, not literal-DAG completion
findings.evidence: Independent recount is 396 rows, 462 path + 130 query bindings, 113 unique command operations and 216 JSON + 12 none + 2 multipart command rows. The current static checker and self-test pass while the catalog retains the legacy keys.
findings.risk: The correct counts could be misreported as executable fixture or dynamic acceptance evidence.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: Correcting the two response mismatches before final fixture execution is the right problem and preserves the catalog owner and canonical contract.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: Split the bounded five-file owner/consumer response correction from later fixture catalog/materializer conversion; this is smaller than expanding an ambiguous unit and avoids generic dispatch or product/API change.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: The missing work is limited to exact source denominators and one focused edge proof, not a new telemetry system, query bus, capability, endpoint or runtime environment.

conclusion.summary: Independent Round 1 DESIGN review is NO_GO (M=2, S=1, N=1). The design cannot pass its own bound admission, conflates a five-file owner/consumer repair with an undeclared literal-DAG materialization, and lacks a focused governed HTTP handoff proof.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: DESIGN review only. No implementation, source or contract mutation, generated output, DEV/runtime, seed/reset, Testcontainers, browser L2, UAT, data operation or repository-control action is authorized.
